faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before you start copying trades

items.q: What's the difference between a demo and a real account?
items.a: A demo account lets you try copy trading with virtual funds risk-free, while a real account reflects your actual balance. You can choose and change your account type anytime from the settings page after signing up.
Once you follow a trader, every trade they execute — opening or closing — is copied to your account automatically with the same details, the moment it happens, with no manual action from you.

items.q: Can I stop copying at any time?
items.a: Yes, you can stop copying any trader instantly, anytime, from your portfolio page, with no conditions or waiting period.

items.q: Can I copy more than one trader at the same time?
items.a: No, the system is designed so you copy only one trader at a time, to keep risk management clear. However, you can follow as many traders' performance as you like without copying them, and you'll receive their performance details by email — then pick one to actually copy. You can stop copying your current trader and copy another anytime.

items.q: What's the minimum required to start copying?
items.a: The minimum varies from one trader to another, and is shown clearly on each trader's profile before you start following.

items.q: Are there any hidden fees or commissions?
items.a: No, there are no hidden commissions or fees on copying trades or on realized profits, no matter how large.

items.q: Do I need to install a separate trading platform?
items.a: No, tracking traders' performance and copying their trades happens entirely from within the Copy Matrix dashboard, with no need to install any external app or platform.

items.q: How do I deposit or withdraw?
items.a: You can submit a deposit or withdrawal request from your portfolio page at any time, and it will be reviewed and approved by our admin team before it reflects on your balance.
